summary: Apollo IG Core Replacement, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered issuance of limited partnership interests for $500M cash under Regulation D/S, an amendment to its partnership agreement adding aggregator entities, and a net asset value disclosure of $1,836.8M as of May 31, 2026. These are routine operational and capital-raising activities for an investment fund, not a special situation. The filing describes a continuous private offering, structural amendments, and periodic NAV reporting, none of which constitute an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The company remains in normal course.
